75cb8a1146.q: Where was Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁ buried?
c: Beside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
75cb8a1146.e: Abu Bakr ﵁ asked to be buried beside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he was buried there.

d83da74362.q: Through whom did ʿUmar ﵁ pray for rain for the people in the Year of Ashes (ʿAm al-Ramada)?
d83da74362.e: In the Year of Ashes ʿUmar ﵁ prayed for rain for the people through al-ʿAbbas.

94049c06c6.q: On whose advice was the calendar dated from the Hijra?
94049c06c6.e: The calendar was dated from the Hijra, in Rabiʿ al-Awwal, on the advice of ʿAli ﵁.

9a7fa6add6.q: Which caliph fixed the stipends, set up the registers (diwans) and gave allowances by precedence in Islam?
9a7fa6add6.e: ʿUmar ﵁ fixed the stipends, set up the registers and gave allowances by precedence in Islam.

0462fb9d6c.q: Which of these was NOT one of the six among whom ʿUmar ﵁ left the caliphate to be decided by consultation?
0462fb9d6c.e: ʿUmar left it to consultation among ʿUthman, ʿAli, Talha, al-Zubayr, ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf and Saʿd.

44b380e212.q: Who led the funeral prayer over ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁?
44b380e212.e: Suhayb led the funeral prayer over ʿUmar ﵁ in the mosque.

765441b7fc.q: Who took charge of the pledge after the consultation and said, “I have seen that the people will accept none but ʿUthman”?
765441b7fc.e: ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf sat to receive the pledge and said: “I have seen that the people will accept none but ʿUthman.”

a98950b30e.q: Who was the first to add the first adhan for the Friday prayer?
a98950b30e.e: ʿUthman ﵁ was the first to add the first adhan for Friday.

e115a3caa3.q: Who was the first to unite the people on a single mode (harf) of reciting the Qurʾan?
e115a3caa3.e: Among ʿUthman's ﵁ firsts: he was the first to unite the people on a single mode of recitation.

4b006918d6.q: In which year was ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan ﵁ killed?
4b006918d6.e: ʿUthman ﵁ was killed in the year 35 AH.

fd671ed7d5.q: In which city was the Battle of the Camel?
fd671ed7d5.e: The Battle of the Camel was at Basra.

356776f062.q: Whom did ʿAli ﵁ choose as arbiter after Siffin?
356776f062.e: ʿAli ﵁ chose Abu Musa al-Ashʿari as arbiter, and Muʿawiya chose ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs.

9c43c3511a.q: Where did ʿAli ﵁ fight the Khawarij and defeat them?
9c43c3511a.e: ʿAli ﵁ marched against the Khawarij and defeated them at al-Nahrawan in the year 38 AH.

83821c27f4.q: How long was al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ﵄ caliph?
83821c27f4.e: Al-Hasan ﵁ became caliph by the pledge of the people of Kufa and held it for six months and some days.

233158584f.q: What was the year called in which al-Hasan ﵁ handed the caliphate to Muʿawiya?
233158584f.e: It was called the Year of Unity because the Umma came together in it under one caliph.

cffbb89342.q: Who was the first to appoint his own son as heir to the caliphate?
cffbb89342.e: Muʿawiya was the first to appoint his son as heir, and the first to do so while in good health.

270ad9f8d1.q: Who was the first child born to the Muhajirun after the Hijra?
270ad9f8d1.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr was the first child born to the Muhajirun after the Hijra.

fa72a29510.q: Who was the first to strike dinars with the Qurʾan written on them?
fa72a29510.e: Malik said: the first to strike dinars was ʿAbd al-Malik, and he wrote the Qurʾan on them.

d9ea624524.q: Who was the first to move the state registers from Persian into Arabic?
d9ea624524.e: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwan was the first to move the registers from Persian into Arabic.

b78e2a006b.q: Which Umayyad caliph built the mosque of Damascus?
b78e2a006b.e: Al-Walid ibn ʿAbd al-Malik conquered India and al-Andalus and built the mosque of Damascus.

e5070838c8.q: Who was the last Umayyad caliph?
e5070838c8.e: Marwan al-Himar, Marwan ibn Muhammad ibn Marwan ibn al-Hakam, was the last of the Umayyad caliphs.

8b0cc70cc1.e: Al-Rashid died on campaign at Tus in Khurasan.

857f17035c.q: Which caliph built the city of Surra Man Raʾa (Samarra) and moved there?
857f17035c.e: Al-Muʿtasim moved from Baghdad and built Surra Man Raʾa.

8428e8b7ae.q: Which caliph ended the Mihna, upheld the Sunna and supported its people?
8428e8b7ae.e: After his accession al-Mutawakkil upheld the Sunna, supported its people and ended the Mihna.

e19d818dd3.q: Who led the Tatars when they reached Baghdad?
e19d818dd3.e: The Tatars were led by Hulagu; the caliph's army went out against them and was defeated.

dabd1ac6b4.q: What was the name of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's ﵁ mother?
dabd1ac6b4.e: Abu Bakr's mother was Salma bint Sakhr, known as Umm al-Khayr.

8ee42545d5.q: When was the Battle of Ajnadayn?
8ee42545d5.e: The Battle of Ajnadayn was in Jumada al-Ula of the year 13 AH.

0b5e9c0b47.q: In which year did Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁ die, and how old was he?
0b5e9c0b47.e: Abu Bakr ﵁ died with eight days of Jumada al-Akhira remaining in 13 AH, aged sixty-three.

33b2923480.q: Who did Abu Bakr ﵁ ask to wash his body?
33b2923480.e: Abu Bakr asked that his wife Asmaʾ bint ʿUmays wash him, helped by his son ʿAbd al-Rahman.

483e9a02e9.q: What was the name of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab's ﵁ mother?
483e9a02e9.e: ʿUmar's ﵁ mother was Hantama bint Hisham ibn al-Mughira, the sister of Abu Jahl.

4043a11438.q: Where did Saʿd ﵁ hold the first Friday prayer ever held in Iraq?
c: In the hall (iwan) of Khosrow at al-Madaʾin
4043a11438.e: Saʿd held the Friday prayer in the hall of Khosrow at al-Madaʾin; it was the first Friday prayer held in Iraq.

31ea38bac4.q: In which year was Nahavand conquered?
31ea38bac4.e: Alexandria and Nahavand were taken by force in the year 21 AH.

77cd2233dd.q: What was engraved on the ring of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁?
77cd2233dd.e: The engraving on ʿUmar's ﵁ ring was: “Death is enough of an admonisher.”

72c683ad82.q: In which year did ʿUthman ﵁ enlarge and extend the Sacred Mosque?
72c683ad82.e: ʿUthman ﵁ enlarged and extended the Sacred Mosque in the year 26 AH.

96a4c90524.q: Who led the naval campaign against Cyprus in the caliphate of ʿUthman ﵁?
c: ʿAbd Allah ibn Saʿd ibn Abi Sarh
96a4c90524.e: Muʿawiya campaigned against Cyprus, taking the armies by sea, in the caliphate of ʿUthman.

5040ece850.q: Who campaigned in Ifriqiya and conquered it in the caliphate of ʿUthman ﵁?
c: ʿAbd Allah ibn Saʿd ibn Abi Sarh
5040ece850.e: ʿUthman made ʿAbd Allah ibn Saʿd ibn Abi Sarh governor of Egypt; he campaigned in Ifriqiya and conquered it.

8a88bd71d7.q: Who was the mother of ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁?
8a88bd71d7.e: ʿAli's ﵁ mother was Fatima bint Asad ibn Hashim, the first Hashimite woman to bear a Hashimite.

16299844fe.q: Who was the first caliph from Banu Hashim?
16299844fe.e: ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁ was the first caliph from Banu Hashim.

3c5ed5f03c.q: When did ʿAli and Muʿawiya meet at Siffin?
3c5ed5f03c.e: The two sides met at Siffin in Safar of the year 37 AH.

85a9ac99f2.q: When did Muʿawiya ibn Abi Sufyan die?
85a9ac99f2.e: Muʿawiya died in Rajab 60 AH and was buried between Bab al-Jabiya and Bab al-Saghir.

b970107c10.q: Who was the mother of Yazid ibn Muʿawiya?
b970107c10.e: Yazid ibn Muʿawiya's mother was Maysun bint Bahdal al-Kalbiyya.

8b79dbb389.q: Whom did ʿAbd al-Malik send to fight Ibn al-Zubayr in Makkah?
8b79dbb389.e: ʿAbd al-Malik sent al-Hajjaj with forty thousand men; he besieged Ibn al-Zubayr in Makkah and bombarded him with catapults.

dc597e87cd.q: In which year was the whole of al-Andalus conquered, in the caliphate of al-Walid?
dc597e87cd.e: The whole of al-Andalus was conquered in the year 92 AH.

c0eddd7ea5.q: Where was ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz born?
c: At Hulwan, a village in Egypt
c0eddd7ea5.e: ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz was born at Hulwan, a village in Egypt, where his father was governor.

0d436c242a.q: Where did ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz die?
c: At Dayr Simʿan, in the district of Homs
0d436c242a.e: ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz died at Dayr Simʿan in the district of Homs.

72f83bfc8a.q: Where was Marwan ibn Muhammad, the last Umayyad caliph, killed?
c: At the village of Busir in Egypt
72f83bfc8a.e: Marwan fled to Egypt and was killed at the village of Busir in Dhu al-Hijjah.

4fb610eec6.q: Where did Abu al-ʿAbbas al-Saffah receive the pledge as caliph?
4fb610eec6.e: Al-Saffah received the pledge in Kufa on the 3rd of Rabiʿ al-Awwal 132 AH.

f7fc055c84.q: Who was the first caliph to appoint his freedmen (mawali) to office and put them ahead of the Arabs?
f7fc055c84.e: Al-Mansur was the first caliph to appoint his freedmen to office and put them ahead of the Arabs.

927ad6bdee.q: Who was the mother of Harun al-Rashid?
927ad6bdee.e: Al-Rashid's mother was a concubine-mother named al-Khayzuran, who was also the mother of al-Hadi.

bc7c6e314e.e: Al-Maʾmun died at al-Badhandun on the Byzantine frontier and was carried to Tarsus and buried there.

49124baf70.q: How old was al-Muqtadir bi-llah when he became caliph?
49124baf70.e: No one younger than al-Muqtadir had become caliph before him; he took office at thirteen.

b12d6c4596.q: Who was the last Abbasid caliph in Iraq?
c: Al-Mustaʿsim bi-llah ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mustansir
b12d6c4596.e: Al-Mustaʿsim bi-llah ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mustansir was the last of the caliphs in Iraq.

f75d055b73.q: Which Companion was the first to lay out Basra, on ʿUmar's order?
f75d055b73.e: ʿUtba ibn Ghazwan, a Companion who fought at Badr, was the first to lay out Basra on ʿUmar's order.

cc180cb885.q: When ʿUmar removed Khalid from command in Syria, whom did he appoint in his place?
cc180cb885.e: When the caliphate passed to ʿUmar he removed Khalid and appointed Abu ʿUbayda, telling him to consult Khalid.

2d34317dd5.q: Whom did Ibn ʿAsakir say was the first to be called “Commander of Commanders” in Syria?
2d34317dd5.e: Ibn ʿAsakir said of Abu ʿUbayda: he was the first to be called Commander of Commanders in Syria.

6463f3d139.q: Which Companion conquered al-Jazira and was the first to cross the Byzantine pass on campaign?
6463f3d139.e: ʿIyad ibn Ghanm al-Fihri conquered al-Jazira and was the first to cross the Byzantine pass on campaign.

e912466fcd.q: Which well had ʿUthman endowed for the Muslims, only to be denied its water when he was besieged?
e912466fcd.e: ʿUthman reminded them that he had endowed the well of Ruma for the Muslims, yet he was the first to be denied its water when they besieged him.

81507a5d01.q: Who was the first to pledge allegiance to ʿAli ﵁ on the pulpit that Friday?
81507a5d01.e: When ʿAli went up the pulpit on Friday, the first to pledge to him was Talha with his crippled hand, then al-Zubayr.

d5c25ddea5.q: Who was the first to pray in the eastern part of the Damascus church that was made a mosque?
d5c25ddea5.e: Abu ʿUbayda made the eastern half of the church a mosque, and he was the first to pray in it, then the Companions.

3917b4ca26.q: Who was the first to greet Abu al-ʿAbbas al-Saffah as caliph?
3917b4ca26.e: The first to greet al-Saffah as caliph was Abu Salama al-Khallal, on Friday night, the 13th of Rabiʿ al-Akhir.

02f927dea5.q: How old was Abu al-ʿAbbas al-Saffah when he was greeted as caliph in Kufa?
02f927dea5.e: They greeted Abu al-ʿAbbas al-Saffah as caliph in Kufa when he was twenty-six.

afbb362556.q: Who was the first to bring the science of hadith and the school of al-Awzaʿi to al-Andalus?
afbb362556.e: Saʿsaʿa ibn Sallam of Damascus moved to al-Andalus and was the first to bring the science of hadith and the school of al-Awzaʿi there.

4387fc2b7e.q: Who was the first to take the title “Shahanshah”, King of Kings?
4387fc2b7e.e: ʿAdud al-Dawla Abu Shujaʿ, son of Rukn al-Dawla ibn Buya the Daylamite, was the first to be called Shahanshah, meaning King of Kings.

7358e1fc6a.q: Who was the first to take Syria back from the Fatimids?
7358e1fc6a.e: Al-Aqsis is Atsiz al-Khwarazmi, titled al-Malik al-Muʿazzam; he was the first to take Syria back from the Fatimids.

b203b9102a.q: What did ʿAbd al-Muttalib ask of Abraha when he came before him?
c: To return two hundred camels he had seized from him
To turn back from destroying the Kaʿba
To give him a third of the wealth of Tihama
b203b9102a.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib told Abraha's interpreter: “My need is that the king return to me two hundred camels he has seized from me.”

7b7141d3ff.q: How did ʿAbd al-Muttalib answer Abraha when he reproached him for not speaking about the House?
c: “I am the lord of the camels, and the House has a Lord who will protect it”
“The Abyssinians will not be able to take it”
7b7141d3ff.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib said: “I am the lord of the camels, and the House has a Lord who will protect it.”

e8978bc184.q: Who spoke to Abraha until he allowed ʿAbd al-Muttalib to come before him?
e8978bc184.e: Unays spoke to Abraha and said: “This is the master of Quraysh at your door asking to see you,” and he allowed him in.

392b86744e.q: What did the chiefs of Banu Bakr and Hudhayl offer Abraha to turn back and not destroy the House?
c: A third of the wealth of Tihama
392b86744e.e: Yaʿmar ibn Nufatha and Khuwaylid ibn Wathila offered Abraha a third of the wealth of Tihama to turn back, and he refused.

88cada5889.q: What did ʿAbd al-Muttalib do after ordering Quraysh to leave Makkah?
c: He held the door-ring of the Kaʿba, calling on Allah
He led his people out to fight Abraha
He went to the king of Yemen for help
He sent to Caesar asking for aid
88cada5889.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib took hold of the door-ring of the Kaʿba, and some men of Quraysh stood with him calling on Allah for help against Abraha.

8d9d963473.q: What was Yaʿqub ibn ʿUtba told was first seen in the land of the Arabs in the Year of the Elephant?
8d9d963473.e: Yaʿqub ibn ʿUtba was told that measles and smallpox were first seen in the land of the Arabs that year.

f4d2408f0c.q: According to Ibn Hisham, what does “al-ababil” mean?
f4d2408f0c.e: Ibn Hisham said: al-ababil means flocks; the Arabs have no singular for it that we know of.

958f4d83e1.q: What does “sijjil” mean to the Arabs, as Ibn Hisham reports?
958f4d83e1.e: Yunus the grammarian and Abu ʿUbayda told Ibn Hisham that sijjil, to the Arabs, means hard and solid.

9d1a29a767.q: To which city was Abraha carried after his body was struck?
9d1a29a767.e: They carried Abraha out, losing him fingertip by fingertip, until they brought him to Sanaʿa.

aba0233854.q: Who was the first to change the religion of Ismaʿil and set up idols?
aba0233854.e: The Prophet ﷺ said of ʿAmr ibn Luhayy that he was the first to change the religion of Ismaʿil and set up idols.

98f15004fe.q: What was Abu Hurayra's name according to one of the two views Ibn Hisham mentions?
98f15004fe.e: Ibn Hisham said: Abu Hurayra's name was ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAmir, and it is also said ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Sakhr.

a78adecfc5.q: What was the name of the idol ʿAmr ibn Luhayy took from the Amalekites and set up in Makkah?
a78adecfc5.e: The Amalekites gave ʿAmr ibn Luhayy an idol called Hubal; he brought it to Makkah and set it up.

9b2f1cc38c.q: Where did ʿAmr ibn Luhayy see people worshipping idols?
c: At Maʾab in the land of al-Balqaʾ
9b2f1cc38c.e: ʿAmr ibn Luhayy went to Syria, and when he came to Maʾab in the land of al-Balqaʾ he saw the Amalekites worshipping idols.

61d6820276.q: How did the worship of stones begin among the sons of Ismaʿil, according to Ibn Ishaq?
c: A traveller would carry a stone of the Haram to honour it
They carved statues of their forefathers
They took it from the Byzantines
They worshipped the stars and made images of them
61d6820276.e: None of them left Makkah without carrying a stone of the Haram to honour it, until they came to worship stones.

5ec5dc96d4.q: Where did Quraysh set up the idol Hubal?
c: Over a well inside the Kaʿba
5ec5dc96d4.e: Ibn Ishaq said: Quraysh set up an idol over a well inside the Kaʿba, called Hubal.

a9adb3a77a.q: At which spot did Quraysh set up Isaf and Naʾila?
a9adb3a77a.e: Ibn Ishaq said: they set up Isaf and Naʾila at the site of Zamzam and sacrificed beside them.

4be8860063.q: Where was al-ʿUzza, the idol of Quraysh and Banu Kinana?
4be8860063.e: Ibn Ishaq said: Quraysh and Banu Kinana had al-ʿUzza at Nakhla.

70247bedf0.q: What would an Arab man do with the idol of his house when he set out on a journey?
70247bedf0.e: When one of them set out on a journey he would stroke it as he mounted, and stroke it again on return before going in to his family.

53a2457113.q: What were the “tawaghit” the Arabs set up alongside the Kaʿba?
c: Houses they honoured as they honoured the Kaʿba
53a2457113.e: The Arabs had set up tawaghit alongside the Kaʿba: houses they honoured as they honoured the Kaʿba, with custodians and doorkeepers.

185fc60a76.q: What is the “saʾiba” in Ibn Ishaq's explanation?
c: A she-camel that bore ten females in a row with no male among them
A she-camel sacrificed to the idols
A stallion ridden for ten years
185fc60a76.e: Ibn Ishaq said: the saʾiba was a she-camel that bore ten females in a row with no male among them; she was set free and never ridden.

b815b57d1a.q: Who built al-Khawarnaq for al-Nuʿman, giving rise to the saying “He rewarded me as … was rewarded”?
b815b57d1a.e: Sinimmar built al-Khawarnaq for al-Nuʿman, who threw him from the top, so the Arabs said: “He rewarded me as Sinimmar was rewarded.”

cbce38e582.q: Whom did Qusayy ibn Kilab marry, who bore him ʿAbd al-Dar and ʿAbd Manaf?
cbce38e582.e: Qusayy asked Hulayl ibn Hubshiyya for his daughter Hubba, and she bore him ʿAbd al-Dar, ʿAbd Manaf, ʿAbd al-ʿUzza and ʿAbd.

d625a4a124.q: Who was Qusayy's brother through his mother, to whom he wrote asking for help?
d625a4a124.e: Qusayy wrote to his half-brother Rizah ibn Rabiʿa asking for help, and he came out to him with his brothers.

b2e2e04c49.q: What did the slave-girl Sukhayla advise about the inheritance of a hermaphrodite?
c: That the ruling follow the place of urination
That they receive half of each share
That the ruling be left to the soothsayer
That they be counted simply as a man
b2e2e04c49.e: Sukhayla said: “Let the ruling follow the place of urination: if they urinate as a man does, they are a man, otherwise a woman.”

9a63a5e0ed.q: What did Quraysh call Qusayy when he united their affairs?
9a63a5e0ed.e: Quraysh called Qusayy “Mujammiʿ” for uniting their affairs, and took his leadership as a good omen.

ff0943a2de.q: Which house did Qusayy set up, where Quraysh settled their affairs?
ff0943a2de.e: Qusayy set up Dar al-Nadwa for himself with its door facing the Kaʿba, and there Quraysh settled their affairs.

cbde852496.q: What was the “rifada” that Qusayy imposed on Quraysh?
c: A levy from their wealth to make food for the pilgrims
Keeping the keys of the Kaʿba
cbde852496.e: The rifada was a levy Quraysh paid Qusayy from their wealth every season, with which he made food for the pilgrims.

5446c5a326.q: What reason did Qusayy give Quraysh for feeding the pilgrims?
c: That the pilgrims are Allah's guests and visitors of His House
That the pilgrims pay a fee
That the pilgrims are their relatives
5446c5a326.e: Qusayy said: “O Quraysh, you are the neighbours of Allah … the pilgrims are Allah's guests and the visitors of His House, the guests most deserving of honour.”

0b7104ff19.q: Where did Hashim ibn ʿAbd Manaf die?
0b7104ff19.e: Hashim ibn ʿAbd Manaf died at Gaza in Syria while trading.

384cbbcfa9.q: What did Quraysh call al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf for his generosity and virtue?
384cbbcfa9.e: Quraysh called al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf al-Fayd for his generosity and virtue.

e6849a3f1a.q: Whom did Hashim ibn ʿAbd Manaf marry in Madinah?
c: Salma bint ʿAmr of Banu ʿAdi ibn al-Najjar
e6849a3f1a.e: Hashim came to Madinah and married Salma bint ʿAmr, of Banu ʿAdi ibn al-Najjar.

2c9ef61576.q: What name did Salma give her son ʿAbd al-Muttalib?
2c9ef61576.e: Salma bore Hashim ʿAbd al-Muttalib and named him Shayba.

c: Because Quraysh thought he was a slave his uncle al-Muttalib had bought
Because his father asked for it
Because he was born in al-Muttalib's house
226e385bdb.e: His uncle al-Muttalib brought him into Makkah riding behind him, and Quraysh said: “A slave al-Muttalib has bought” - and so he was named.

c7bce3d90e.q: Where did al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf die?
c7bce3d90e.e: Al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf died at Radman in Yemen.

e75b48a03a.q: Which well was ʿAbd al-Muttalib told in a dream to dig?
e75b48a03a.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib saw in his dream someone telling him: “Dig Zamzam; it will never run dry and never be blamed.”

fb684a08ab.q: Who was with ʿAbd al-Muttalib when he dug Zamzam?
fb684a08ab.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib went out with his pickaxe and his son al-Harith, then his only son, and dug.
